Infer unseen garment construction conservatively and consistently. This is a girl: retain her childhood age and age-appropriate anatomy, no adult makeover, no makeup, no sexualized pose or clothing. Keep eyes fresh without eye bags.  STRICT CROP: every panel is a HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS CLOSE-UP cropped at upper chest, no waist, no hips, no legs, no full-body figures. Face large enough to inspect features.
